assets.label: CÁMARA
assets.promptLiteral:
Create one isolated runtime support icon representing a simple editorial camera.

Style: premium editorial technical monoline icon, visually compatible with Cipher’s existing PERSONAS, DATOS, SOLUCIONES and IMPACTO Supports. Clean black ink linework, consistent rounded stroke, minimal geometry, centered composition.

Output: one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha and generous transparent margins. The icon only.

Constraints: black monochrome line art only; no color accents; no card; no label; no text; no logo; no watermark; no border; no shadow; no background; no paper texture; no green screen; no checkerboard; no mockup; no filled illustration; no scenery.

The Cipher renderer will create the card, label, connector, shadow and selectable color later.
